problem: The 999 menu displayed three persistent realm labels, hard-coded the EXPLAIN petal as a cyan pulse, and covered the shared Trios glass with opaque Queen black layers.
solution: Added a tested presentation policy, disabled the realm labels, removed the EXPLAIN-only animation, gave every idle petal the same translucent neutral fill, introduced an explicit host-glass Queen surface style, and removed redundant black backgrounds from the embedded host path.
lesson: An embedded interface must expose transparency deliberately at every root layer. One opaque fallback can hide the host material, while a special-case animation can make a single navigation target look selected even when it is idle.
